project.name: osgi/domains/dataplan/dataplan-ingress-contract
project.description: The HOST face of the dataplan contract — what BOTH realms genuinely consume: the one coordinate the dataplan scion stores its layout at and the host fetches it back from (the plan CLI's export renders the dataset tree from there). dataplan-contract is type=contract, OSGi-only, so the host cannot compile against it, and spelling the slug as a string host-side is the mismatch the single-source-of-truth discipline forbids. type=dual-realm, like netplan-ingress-contract: staged as a bundle OSGi-side AND kept flat host-side. The layout itself crosses as JSON (the host reads it as a JsonNode, never a dataplan type).
